english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a fabricated thing or an untrue claim.
This is the all-purpose choice for something not real and can also describe someone or something as insincere.
This is the all-purpose choice for something fake or not genuine.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken adjective for something fake, not genuine, or broadly bogus.
This is the all-purpose choice for something fake, false, or not genuine.
Use this when the emphasis is that something is not genuine or is a cheap imitation.
